functional_roles.description: Read-only inspection that reports current state and must not mutate the repository or evidence records.
Read-only pass/fail validation. It may call audit helpers but must not create the proof it validates.
Evidence writer. It must consume authority/runtime/test outputs and write evidence; it must not convert unknown or red runtime state into green proof.
Runtime observation collector. It may query local/disposable/staging systems but should not mutate application data unless explicitly declared.
Artifact generator. It must expose check/read-only mode or be clearly marked mutating.
Intentional repository mutation such as applying bundles, migrations, maintenance or code-generation outputs. It is never standalone release proof.
Cleanup, repair, inventory or operational maintenance scripts. Must be explicitly marked release-blocking or advisory.

reviewed_contract.purpose: Classify scripts by release-evidence domain and function so scripts are operational tools with explicit mutability, evidence, and runtime contracts rather than unstructured helper sprawl.
reviewed_contract.release_gate_policy: Script output is supporting evidence only. Product/runtime/security release claims require scripts in the product/runtime/advisory classes to execute behaviour or checks and emit current command results; governance/capture scripts cannot generate their own proof from constants.

required_command_groups.purpose: List product-behaviour scripts and their declared functional roles.
List runtime/stack scripts and their readiness-probe roles.
List governance/evidence scripts and docs/register sync duties.

script_classes.description: Scripts that exercise or support product behaviour: services, routes, DB-backed auth, POPIA, billing, learner journeys, diagnostics, lessons, study plans and parent portal.
required_capabilities: execute real product behaviour where possible
declare required fixtures or live stack requirements
avoid substituting governance evidence for product proof

script_classes.description: Scripts that prove stack and operational health: Postgres, Redis, Alembic migrations, schema, /ready, worker, frontend proxy, readiness and runtime probes.
required_capabilities: fail closed on missing critical dependency
compare live migration revision to known repository head

script_classes.description: Scripts that manage or verify PRD records, registers, evidence files, authority transitions, documentation synchronisation and freshness.
required_capabilities: avoid claiming product/runtime readiness without external command outputs

script_classes.description: Scripts that run or verify static/advisory gates: Ruff, mypy, Bandit, coverage, dependency audit, OpenAPI drift, route inventory and generated artifacts.
required_capabilities: run read-only check mode where possible
avoid rewriting reports during check-only execution
record accepted-risk disposition when not green
